msg: The 1st gnome that you pick should just be a random pick, if the number of mushrooms is above 4 then click again as it should give a bigger number. The tall hats were good for me to bring in high numbers, so the first thing to do is to figure out which style of hat brings in the low score. Keep changing what you chose because they do work off each other e.g, if you click a tall hat twice, you'll notice for the third time the score will lower so it's then time to click the smaller hat. If a hat reveals a low score of 0,1,2,3 then leave it and focus on the other hat.
